sentences.text: Alberta reported concerns about pulp mills, including issues surrounding pulp and paper effluent, dioxin, and gas emissions.

Alberta expressed concerns about pesticides and herbicides, including issues related to the disposal of containers, risks for family members on farms and in horticultural activities, and run-off into drinking water systems.

Alberta reported human health concerns related to air quality raised by various stakeholder groups including First Nations, environmental associations, governments, and the Clean Air Strategic Alliance.

Environmental health concerns in Alberta included tracking the impact of global concerns like climate change, checking drinking water supplies, investigating complaints about sub-standard housing, recalling contaminated foods, and assessing the impact of environmental hazards on health.

Alberta identified weaknesses in environmental health arrangements including lack of direction at an interdepartmental level, lack of a unified voice and confused information, lack of uniformity in applying standards, absence of technical resources and skills to deal with new health issues, and weak environmental impact assessment procedures.
